releaseNotes:
Kujo 1.5.0 adds confined streaming SHA-256 and exact-byte file copies with bounded memory, atomic no-replace publication, and explicit filesystem capabilities. Bounded directory pagination supports larger local evidence collections. It preserves the existing smaller digest API and includes upstream bounded-stdin and lexical-scope fixes.

The complete release gate, native upgrade checks, five native builds, and npm packaging passed in [run 35787043614](https://github.com/kujolang/kujo/actions/runs/35787043614). Source revision: `cc2d7dbb59a8dc05f00d629e100932f56f4062f6`, integrated through PR #10. CLI/language contract versions remain 1.0.0; preview APIs retain their documented guarantees.

Download the archive for your platform and verify its SHA-256 using the accompanying file or `checksums.txt`. The signed v1.5.0 tag also contains all five archive digests. Native archives are the canonical distribution; this release does not publish a Cargo registry package. npm 1.5.0 publication remains blocked: the separate publisher returned registry E404; the public npm channel remains 1.4.0 pending maintainer authorization review.

[Published-download installation checks](https://github.com/kujolang/kujo/actions/runs/35793560616) passed on Linux x64/ARM64, macOS x64/ARM64 and Windows x64. The first macOS ARM64 upgrade check hit a public GitHub API rate limit; its unchanged retry passed. These checks are not a universal enterprise-readiness certification.
